meta.description: How to find the house on the way to Fushimi Inari, how to reserve, and what to expect when you come.

label: Plan Your Visit
title: Plan Your Visit
intro: The house is on the way to Fushimi Inari. Come before the crowds, or after.

sections.heading: Reserve or enquire
body: Tell us when you would like to come and how many you are. We will reply by email.

faq.question: Do I need to know tea ceremony?
faq.answer: No. Tea is prepared in front of you and we will explain as much or as little as you like.

faq.question: Is the house accessible?
faq.answer: This is an old house. The first floor and the garden are accessible, but the second floor and the basement can only be reached by stairs. If you have a question about getting around, write to us and we will answer plainly.

faq.question: Can children visit?
faq.answer: Of course. Please keep a close eye on your children so that they stay safe.

faq.question: Which languages do you speak?
faq.answer: We can assist you in English, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean.
